verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own one-click migration between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted, and a native PostgreSQL option you connect to directly with psql. Storage also offers download and list APIs, so data can be taken out and run on your own infrastructure. However, no documented bulk 'export all data' feature or open-format export (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps covering databases, users and files) appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export in open formats, coverage of auth/user data export, and independent hands-on corroboration of a complete exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can also migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted.
A dedicated, native PostgreSQL database you connect to directly.
It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files
Appwrite was designed from the ground up with self-hosting in mind.
